Priya (CS): SundialBank weekly health check. TL;DR: tokens ~640k (-2% w/w), avg_batch_size 1.8, cache hit rate 7% (down 5pp), cost per 1k tokens $3.10 (up 22%). p95 latency 360ms (stable). Renewal in 3 weeks — we need a quick mitigation plan and a customer-facing summary.
Hector (Eng): I scanned request headers. Mobile SDK started sending unique session IDs per request after last release, which prevents coalescing and reduces cache prefix reuse. That explains batch=1.8 and hit drop.
Avery (SRE): Agree. Also seeing more long-tail sessions causing KV cache churn. Cold-cache evictions increased by ~12% overnight.
Luis (PM): If it's SDK-induced, what are tradeoffs between asking them to revert vs server-side fixes we can ship fast?
Hector (Eng): Server-side options: (1) session-key normalization (strip variable suffixes) for a subset of routes; (2) server-side short buffer coalesce (50ms) for api/v1/chat only; (3) targeted prefetch of top 250 prefixes. Option 1 has some correctness risk; option 2/3 lower risk and faster.
Avery (SRE): Prefetch combined with a slightly larger in-memory prefix store should give us ~+4pp hit within 24-48h. Coalesce buffer will likely increase avg_batch to ~2.8 but may add ~10-20ms to p95 for those routes.
Priya (CS): Customer is sensitive to latency on their live chat flow. They won't like an increase. I can ask them to roll back the SDK change as an ask-first approach. If they decline we need a low-latency server-side plan.
Hector (Eng): Proposed conservative config for server-side coalesce scoped to non-interactive endpoints (we can exclude "/chat/live"):
```
service.sundialbank.batching:
  coalesce_window_ms: 50
  max_batch_size: 12
  scope: ["/v1/generate", "/v1/summary"]
```
That avoids live chat.
Avery (SRE): Prefetch job plan: seed top-250 prefixes, schedule warm-up 03:00-05:00 UTC, monitor eviction rate and hit delta. Link to job plan (internal): https://redwood.internal/jobs/prefetch-sundialbank
Luis (PM): For the renewal deck we need: (a) root cause (SDK session IDs), (b) proposed steps and expected impact (prefetch + scoped coalesce => hit +4pp, batch +55% => cost -14% => est $2.67/1k tokens), (c) risk/mitigations (latency change confined to non-live routes, rollback request to customer). Priya will own the slide.
Priya (CS): I'll ask the account to roll back and give them the server-side fallback plan if they can't. Also will add the cost estimate and timelines. @Hector please give a 1-liner for ops; @Avery please add monitoring thresholds.
Hector (Eng): Ops 1-liner: will deploy scoped coalesce + prefetch flag gated behind feature-flag; quick rollback path if p95 impact > +40ms.
Avery (SRE): Monitoring thresholds: alert if cache hit delta < +2pp after 24h or p95 increases > 30ms on any core route. Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sundialbank-cache-batching
billing-bot: Spend notice: SundialBank projected monthly run-rate $9.3k, month delta -4%.
Priya (CS): Thanks all. I'll draft the slide and ping for a review in the morning. :thumbsup:
